sentences.text: Hull shape determines how a boat behaves.
A displacement hull pushes through the water, and its top speed, called hull speed, is limited by its waterline length.
A planing hull rises up and skims on the surface once it has enough power and speed, which is how most charter boats travel.
A deep-V bottom cuts through chop and gives a smoother ride, while a flat bottom is very stable at rest and in shallow water but pounds hard in waves.
